title: Edmund and the Hymn
author: Gideon Whitlock
blurb: Oscar Iversen, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
